notes: All scenario inductances are assumptions, not extracted EPC9186 or user PCB values.
Branch_nh denotes an entire local commutation branch; shared_nh includes common high-frequency paths counted once.
The equal-current coupled-branch approximation is L_eff=L_shared+L_branch*(1+(N-1)*k)/N.
Gate common-source inductance must also be explicitly represented in a transient circuit without double-counting it in the branch total.
These are bookkeeping/common-mode estimates, not multi-device SPICE results or field-solver extraction.
